status: bounded feasibility audit; no simulation performed

primary_source.title: The atomistic details of the ice recrystallisation inhibition activity of PVA
primary_source.license: CC BY 4.0 (article and supplementary information, subject to third-party material notices)
primary_source.paper_claim: PVA effective volume and ice contact area correlate with inhibition; this is an indirect molecular-level ice-PVA benchmark, not a direct coalescence/recrystallisation simulation.

reported_benchmark.interface: hexagonal ice primary prismatic face in contact with supercooled water; seeded ice grows in both +/- z directions
reported_benchmark.ice_surface: primary prismatic face cleaved into xy plane
reported_benchmark.ice_restraint: oxygen atoms harmonically position restrained, 10000 kJ/mol; unit transcribed as printed; dimensional implementation of the spring constant must be resolved before reconstruction
reported_benchmark.water_layers: two approximately 11 nm layers, one above and one below the slab
reported_benchmark.boundary_conditions: 2D xy periodicity, Yeh-Berkowitz slab electrostatics correction, 9-3 Lennard-Jones walls at top and bottom
reported_benchmark.cutoffs: van der Waals 12 A with switching to zero at 12 A; electrostatics 10 A
reported_benchmark.constraints: SETTLE water; P-LINCS polymer hydrogen bonds
reported_benchmark.temperature_protocol: ice/water NPT semi-isotropic equilibration at 300 K for 50 ns; add two polymers and equilibrate 20 ns at 300 K; cool to 265 K over 10 ns; production at 265 K
reported_benchmark.polymer_system: two polymers placed in the two water slabs, one above and one below; PVA10, PVA20, 2xPVA10, PVA-b-PVAm variants and restrained PVA20 geometries are studied
reported_benchmark.polymer_equilibration: individual polymer geometry steepest descent, then cubic 7.8 nm water box and 30 ns NPT equilibration at room temperature/ambient pressure using Bussi thermostat and Berendsen barostat
reported_benchmark.concentration: The paper does not state a molar or mass concentration for the simulated slab; polymer count, 90,818 total atoms, slab dimensions and water-layer thickness are reported. Experimental comparison uses 1 mg/mL PVA10/PVA19 and PBS control.

controls_and_outcomes.simulation_control: 20 independent 200 ns ice/water trajectories without polymer
controls_and_outcomes.PVA20: binds in multiple conformations; random-coil/compact/perpendicular cases show sustained slowing or plateauing of ice growth; parallel linear case is more readily overgrown
controls_and_outcomes.PVA10: binds in 19 of 20 simulations but is commonly overgrown by approximately 100 ns and has weaker inhibition
controls_and_outcomes.PVAm: reported not to bind in 20 independent 200 ns simulations
controls_and_outcomes.reported_metrics: largest ice-cluster molecule count versus time, binding defined as 20% hydroxyl groups hydrogen-bonded to ice, hydrogen-bond geometry <0.3 nm and 160-200 degrees, polymer alpha-shape volume/contact area
controls_and_outcomes.experimental_context: splat assay: 10 uL PBS solution, dropped 1.40 m onto cover slip on -78 C plate, annealed 30 min at -8 C; PVA20 strongly reduces mean grain size, PVA10 has weaker activity

public_artifacts.data_record_finding: WRAP record exposes the open-access article PDF and metadata; no downloadable coordinate/topology archive or trajectories were found in the record.
public_artifacts.software_license: GROMACS, PLUMED and MDAnalysis are publicly available open-source packages; MATLAB/alphaShape requires a MathWorks license. The paper does not provide a study-specific repository or executable workflow.

feasibility.status: partial reconstruction feasible; faithful benchmark reproduction not currently turnkey
missing_assets: exact polymer placement/orientation and independent random seeds
PLUMED input files and restraint definitions
trajectory files and raw per-run observables
analysis scripts for s6 clustering, hydrogen bonds and alpha shapes
reported simulated polymer concentration and exact box vectors
validation_required_before_any_claim: rebuild the 90,818-atom slab and verify primary-prismatic orientation
validate TIP4P/Ice geometry, CHARMM36 compatibility, 2D PME/Yeh-Berkowitz and wall terms
run polymer-free ice-growth controls and reproduce qualitative growth statistics
check ice-cluster threshold s6 > 0.45 and hydrogen-bond criteria
compare all reported qualitative PVA10/PVA20/PVAm outcomes across independent runs
label any OpenMM/TIP4P-Ice port as a method-development analogue unless all missing GROMACS details are recovered
feasibility.runtime: The paper reports 200 ns trajectory lengths and HPC facilities (ARCHER and Athena), but no wall-clock, core count, GPU, trajectory size or cost. A reconstructed benchmark needs measured throughput before a budget can be reserved under the existing authorization.
feasibility.scope_boundary: This review supports planning a reconstructable explicit ice-water interface benchmark; it does not establish IRI efficacy, reproduce the assay, or authorize compute spending.
